daily.title: TXT ANNOUNCES WORLD TOUR 2026-2027
daily.description: TXT announces their fifth world tour named " STEAL THE WIND". This tour will kick off in Korea this year on November 13 2026! Keep in mind that NEW dates will be released soon!
